Colors of the built-in themes (ADR-058, ADR-060) are taken from published palettes and adjusted where Gitloom's contrast checks need it. Gitloom is not affiliated with their authors. Warm Dark and Warm Light use Gitloom's own values.

The syntax themes Studio Dark and Dusk (`crates/app/assets/studio-dark.tmTheme`, `crates/app/assets/dusk.tmTheme`) are Gitloom's own files; they take scope rules and color values from the sources below (no file is copied).
